subject: Innovation Hub pilot credits & packaging eligibility review
messages:
From: Samir Khan <samir.k@innovationhub.org>
To: ava_chen@redwood.ai
Cc: partnerships@novalabs.ai
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot credits request for upcoming Innovation Hub cohort

Hi Ava,

Hope you’re well — we’re kicking off a new cohort at Innovation Hub (run by NOVA Labs) in June and would love to propose Redwood as the preferred inference provider for the accelerator's AI track. A couple of things we’re hoping to explore:

- One-off promotional credits for cohort participants (approx 5 startups, light-to-medium usage)
- A straightforward onboarding/package that avoids per-startup procurement (single SOW + seat allocation)
- Any promotional pricing or waived onboarding fees you can offer for first-time partners

I attached a draft SOW and high-level cohort profile. Budget is tight on the partner side — this program is mostly subsidized, so any exception to standard packaging would help get Redwood into the program and (ideally) convert a few pilot customers.

Can we schedule a 30-minute sync this week to discuss? Happy to share cohort details ahead of time.

Thanks,
Samir
Head of Partnerships, Innovation Hub
NOVA Labs

Attachment: InnovationHub-Pilot-SOW.pdf (PDF, 320KB)

From: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Khan <samir.k@innovationhub.org>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot credits request for upcoming Innovation Hub cohort

Hi Samir — thanks for the note and the SOW, this looks promising. I’ve looped in Ben (partnerships lead) and Karthik (pricing/packaging) so we can scope a viable pilot offer. A few quick clarifying questions before a call:

1) Number of unique startup accounts you want provisioned under the SOW (you mentioned ~5, can you confirm max headcount?)
2) Expected average token usage per startup per month (ballpark OK) — helps us size credit buckets vs reserved capacity needs
3) Do you need dedicated capacity (redwood dedicated) or is hosted API acceptable for the pilot?

Proposed next step: 30-min call Wed or Thu morning PT. Ben/Karthik, if you can share a rough accelerator package we can propose (credits + discount + any waived setup fee), I’ll present to Samir on the call.

Ava Chen
Senior Partnerships Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>

Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 19 Apr 2027 10:26:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Pilot credits request for upcoming Innovation Hub cohort

Ava / Karthik — quick draft proposal below for the call. Monica, tagging you for billing/contract signoff and to confirm we can do a single SOW with per-startup allocations under one purchase order.

Summary proposal (internal draft):
- Cohort size: up to 6 startups (list-managed by Innovation Hub)
- Free promo credits: 50k generation tokens + 2000 embedding units per startup (valid 6 months)
- Overage pricing: 20% off our published hosted-API rates during the 6-month period
- Onboarding fee: waived for the cohort (one-time)
- Packaging: single SOW with allocated sub-accounts; invoices to NOVA Labs; startups get admin invites
- Eligibility: startups must be pre-approved by Innovation Hub; credits non-transferable and capped per sub-account

Risks/notes:
- If usage spikes (e.g., >2x token estimate) we may need to convert to reserved capacity or throttle; recommend adding a soft cap and alerting rules.
- Need legal to sign off on SOW language that allows one entity to be billed while maintaining per-startup data isolation controls.

Monica — can we waive the onboarding fee and accept a single SOW billing approach for this partner? If yes, I’ll confirm on the call and prepare an order form.

Thanks,
Ben
Director, Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 16:47:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Pilot credits request for upcoming Innovation Hub cohort — approved package

Hi Samir — great speaking today, appreciate the context on cohort workloads. Quick recap and what we can commit to for this pilot: 

Confirmed offer (Redwood -> Innovation Hub cohort):
- Cohort cap: up to 6 startups managed by Innovation Hub (NOVA Labs)
- Promo credits: 50,000 generation tokens + 2,000 embedding units per startup, valid for 6 months from activation
- Overage: 20% off hosted-API retail rates for any usage beyond credits during the 6-month window
- Onboarding: fee waived for this program (one time)
- Packaging/ops: single SOW and order form; Redwood will provision sub-accounts under the SOW with per-account caps and admin access for Innovation Hub

Conditions and next steps:
- Credits are non-transferable and applied at the sub-account level; Innovation Hub will provide a confirmed list of participant company names/emails two weeks prior to cohort start
- If sustained usage exceeds our hosted thresholds (unpredictable spike across multiple startups), Redwood reserves the right to recommend reserved capacity and will discuss migration costs prior to forced conversion
- Monica will issue the cohort order-form and SOW updates for signature (attached).

I’ve attached the order form — please review and confirm the participant list when you have it. We’re excited to support the cohort and will prioritize onboarding support for the first two startups.

Best,
Ava Chen
Senior Partnerships Manager
Redwood Inference
